record.title: Finland restricts non-exempt land entry and closes secondary routes in the first COVID wave
record.scope: National land-entry regime, with frontier-specific exceptions and partial easing
record.crossings: Designated Norway/Sweden gates; Russian frontier; Vainikkala passenger rail
record.direction: Entry restriction; designated-route restrictions in both directions.
record.movement: Non-exempt passenger entry and use of secondary land routes.
record.exceptions: Return rights, goods, necessary travel and evolving work exceptions; outward travel advice did not abolish constitutional exit rights.
record.enforcement: Border Guard implementation ordered; no all-gate observation assembled.
record.consequences: Restricted cross-border mobility; no quantified impact adopted.
record.relationship: New Finland-side 2020 regime; distinct from Norway-side EU022 and Finnish Russian-tourism/security episodes EU037/EU001/EU002.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; not a present-day status assessment
record.official_rationale: Protect public health and the functioning of healthcare during COVID-19.
record.context: First-wave entry restrictions combined gate closures and essential-purpose admission. The recorded endpoint is formal Norway-land easing only.
record.uncertainty: Initial English announcement uses imperative outward-travel language; later official guidance expressly preserves exit rights. June endpoint does not end Swedish or Russian restrictions.

historical.duration_note: Formal permission or repeal; operational continuity and first physical reopening are not established. Formal partial easing and changing exemptions do not establish a uniform all-frontier operational spell.
